# Regression inputs only

These legacy episodes, element catalogs, and procedural image plates preserve
existing tests for drawing bytes, format fitting, camera/QC behavior, asset
manifests, and custom scene entry points. Their visual quality is not endorsed.
Do not treat the Vox/history placeholders as reconstructions of a reference,
or their layouts as creative direction for a new film.

Local YAML entries and image paths stay relative to their own directory. The
single `ep01-mie-ayam.yaml` input is also copied into the Docker image's `smoke/`
directory for the existing offline CI encode. The other fixture artwork is
excluded from the image. The figures and dates here are historical test data,
not current factual claims or publishing inputs.
